news.title: IU School of Education faculty lead education research for $20 Million NSF grant to advance AI-powered learning
news.summary_en: Researchers with the IU School of Education will lead the education research as part of a five-year, $20 million grant recently awarded by the National Science Foundation (NSF) for the NSF AI Institute for Engaged Learning. This will allow researchers to create artificial intelligence-enabled technology that supports student and teacher agency in narrative-centered learning environments.
